column3: Physical presentation: how to keep face-down objects apart on the table and track how each became face down; the engine identifies objects by id and records how each was turned face down

Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2026-01-27 ruling calls the ability that makes the tokens Shredder's 'last ability', but his last ability is 'Whenever Shredder deals combat damage to a player, that player loses half their life, rounded up.', which makes no tokens; the tokens come from his first ability ('Whenever Shredder attacks a player, for each other opponent, create a token that's a copy of Shredder tapped and attacking that player, except it isn't legendary. ...'), as his other ruling of that day numbers it ('the token copies created by Shredder's first ability'). Likely origin: the token-copy note 'If [card] leaves the battlefield before its [triggered / second / last] ability resolves, the token will still enter as a copy of [card], using [card]'s copiable values from when it was last on the battlefield.', as on Watchful Radstag (2024-03-08, 'before its last ability resolves', right for its token ability, its last), with the ordinal not filled in for Shredder. What the ruling says of the tokens agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_residue_copy_instant_tokens.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
